symptom: Clicking a recommended vacation destination card gave no immediate confirmation, no waiting state and felt much slower than the eventual response.
expected_behavior: The selected card acknowledges the click immediately, prevents duplicate navigation, shows an accessible waiting state, and reaches the selected regional results as quickly as the connection permits.
environment: Production https://vii.co.il and local release candidate on 2026-10-14.

steps: Activate the north destination card and observe the card before the route changes.
reproduction.evidence: Before the repair, the card was a Link with prefetch=false, no click state and no global feedback attributes. Direct production requests measured 0.604s TTFB and 0.809s total for /vacations/north?guests=2, showing that the missing browser feedback amplified the perceived wait.

observations.observation: The destination cards explicitly disabled automatic prefetch and had neither a selected-card state nor global navigation feedback attributes.
The production destination document itself responded in less than one second during direct probes.
observations.evidence: https://vii.co.il/vacations/north?guests=2 returned 200 with 0.604s TTFB and 0.809s total; Kinneret returned 200 in 0.832s total.

observations.observation: The repaired card exposes its pending state before the URL changes.
observations.evidence: Local browser click observed aria-busy=true and 'רק רגע, כבר נכנסים' while the browser was still on the homepage.

hypotheses.mechanism: The destination cards opt out of automatic prefetch and do not perform intent-based prefetch, so route work starts only after activation.
hypotheses.prediction: Source inspection will show prefetch=false without router.prefetch, and adding intent-only warming will preserve the homepage payload policy while starting the chosen route earlier.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the destination-card source with the homepage payload contract, then verify router.prefetch runs only from pointer or keyboard intent handlers.
hypotheses.result: Supported. The pre-fix component had prefetch=false and no manual warmup. The repair keeps automatic bulk prefetch disabled and calls router.prefetch only on pointer intent, focus or pointer down.

hypotheses.mechanism: The route itself always requires more than ten seconds on the production server.
hypotheses.prediction: A direct production request will also exceed ten seconds.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Measure direct production TTFB and total transfer time for at least two regional vacation routes.
hypotheses.result: Rejected. Direct production requests completed in about 0.8 seconds total for two representative regional routes.

hypotheses.mechanism: No selected-card state and no route loading boundary make any real delay appear like a dead click.
hypotheses.prediction: Source inspection will find neither aria-busy nor an in-card loader, and a controlled local click will remain visibly unchanged.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Hold the navigation long enough to inspect the selected card immediately after click and verify aria-busy, visible pending copy and duplicate-click protection.
hypotheses.result: Supported. The repaired browser check observed aria-busy=true and the text 'רק רגע, כבר נכנסים' before navigation, then reached the requested regional heading.

fix.change: Add intent-only route warming, immediate pressed and pending feedback inside the selected card, duplicate-click protection, delayed global progress feedback, and a localized accessible route loading boundary.
fix.evidence: TypeScript, production build, 643 tests and a real local browser click passed. The selected card exposed aria-busy=true before the URL changed and the destination completed at /vacations/north?guests=2.

affected_family: All six recommended vacation destination cards
Hebrew, English, Russian and French loading copy
Keyboard focus, pointer activation and reduced-motion states

regression_checks.check: Production build and complete automated suite
regression_checks.evidence: vinext production build passed and 643 of 643 tests passed.

regression_checks.check: Crawlable regional pages retain a single H1
regression_checks.evidence: Every canonical sitemap URL passed the complete crawlable HTML test after the loading heading was changed to H2.
Localization completeness passed for English, Russian and French.

regression_checks.check: Immediate browser feedback and completed route
regression_checks.evidence: Local browser observed the pending state before navigation and then reached the north regional H1.

remaining_unknowns: Production interaction timing remains pending until the new release is deployed and measured on the public URL.
authorization_boundary: Implement, test and prepare the existing VII site for the user-authorized publication; preserve domain, supplier truth, credentials and unrelated product behavior.
